announcements.text: Raytheon Co., Tewksbury, Massachusetts, was awarded a $1,020,659,819 firm-fixed-price contract for the procurement of NASAMS fire units. Bids were solicited via the internet with one received. Work will be performed in Tewksbury, Massachusetts, with an estimated completion date of May 26, 2031. Fiscal 2026 Foreign Military Sales (Kuwait) funds in the amount of $1,020,659,819 were obligated at the time of the award. Army Contracting Command, Redstone Arsenal, Alabama, is the contracting activity (W31P4Q-26-C-0008).

Lockheed Martin Corp., Grand Prairie, Texas, was awarded a $14,316,595 modification (P00050) to contract W31P4Q-24-C-0007 for engineering services requirements including performance, safety, reliability, maintainability, and product improvement efforts for all production variants of the Multiple Launch Rocket System and related support equipment. The modification brings the total cumulative face value of the contract to $229,954,235. Work will be performed in Grand Prairie, Texas, with an estimated completion date of May 27, 2027. Fiscal 2025 research, development, test and evaluation, Army funds in the amount of $14,316,595 were obligated at the time of the award. Army Contracting Command, Redstone Arsenal, Alabama, is the contracting activity (W31P4Q-24-C-0007).

Lockheed Martin Corp., Lockheed Martin Aeronautics Co., Fort Worth, Texas, is awarded a $100,455,916 firm-fixed-price order (N0001926F0266) against a previously issued basic ordering agreement (N0001924G0010). This order procures 1,459 brake assembly heat sinks, including 1,075 for the F-35A Lightning II conventional takeoff and landing aircraft and 384 for the F-35B Lightning II short takeoff and vertical landing aircraft in support of depot-level brake repairs. This effort supports resolution of existing thermal management constraints, ensures the reliability of critical avionics, and supports forecasted fleet requirements for serviceable brakes to sustain warfighter operational requirements for the Air Force, Navy, Marine Corps, F-35 program partners, and Foreign Military Sales (FMS) customers. Work will be performed in South Bend, Indiana, and is expected to be completed by March 2030. Fiscal 2026 aircraft procurement (Air Force) funds in the amount of $43,795,721; fiscal 2026 aircraft procurement (Navy) funds in the amount of $28,597,475; FMS customer funds in the amount of $10,907,840; and F-35 program partner funds in the amount of $17,154,880, will be obligated at the time if award, none of which will expire at the end of the current fiscal year. This contract action was not competed. Naval Air Systems Command, Patuxent River, Maryland, is the contracting activity.

Chase Supply Inc., of Hampton, VA, is awarded a $30,470,162.50 indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity, firm-fixed-price contract (N3220526D1004) to provide portable lube oil filtering equipment to support machinery operation and maintain fleet readiness. The contract will contain a five year ordering period, and one six-month option period. The contract will be performed beginning May 26, 2026, and will conclude on Nov. 25, 2031, if options are exercised. This contract was full and open and solicited via the Government Point of Entry website; two timely proposals were received. Military Sealift Command, Norfolk, Virginia, is the contracting activity.

E-VAC Magnetics LLC, Sumter, South Carolina, has been awarded a maximum $12,895,550 firm-fixed-price delivery order (SP8000-26-F-0027) issued against five-year contract (SP8000-26-D-0011) for NdFeB magnet blocks. This was a sole-source acquisition using justification 10 U.S. Code 3204 (a)(3)(A), as stated in Federal Acquisition Regulation 6.302-3 (a)(2)(i). The delivery order end date is May 26, 2027. Using military services are Army, Marine Corps, Navy, Air Force, and Space Force. Type of appropriation is fiscal 2025 through 2029 transaction funds. The contracting activity is Defense Logistics Agency Contracting Services Office, Columbus, Ohio.

Noveon Magnetics Inc.,* San Marcos, Texas, has been awarded a maximum $12,894,620 firm-fixed-price delivery order (SP8000-26-F-0026) issued against a five-year contract (SP8000-26-D-0010) for NdFeB magnet block. This was a sole-source acquisition using justification 10 U.S. Code 3204 (a)(3)(A), as stated in Federal Acquisition Regulation 6.302-3 (a)(2)(i). The delivery order end date is May 26, 2027. Using military services are Army, Marine Corps, Navy, Air Force and Space Force. Type of appropriation is fiscal 2025 through 2029 transaction funds. The contracting activity is Defense Logistics Agency Contracting Services Office, Columbus, Ohio.

UPDATE: Kovatch Mobile Equipment Corp., doing business as KME, Nesquehoning, Pennsylvania (SPE8EC-26-D-0016, $523,000,000), has been added as an awardee to the multiple award contract for fire and emergency vehicles, issued against solicitation SPE8EC-21-R-0005 and awarded July 24, 2023. The contracting activity is Defense Logistics Agency Troop Support, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania.

Teledyne Scientific and Imaging LLC, Thousand Oaks, California, was awarded a $12,258,430 modification (P00009) to cost-plus-fixed-fee contract HR001124C0359 for a Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) project. The modification brings the total cumulative value of the contract from $5,933,474 to $18,191,904. Work will be performed in Thousand Oaks, California (61%); Westlake Village, California (8%); Raleigh, North Carolina (9.5%); and Cambridge, Massachusetts (21.5%) with an expected completion date of May 2028. Fiscal 2026 and 2027 research, development, test, and evaluation funds in the amount of $5,500,000 were obligated at time of award. This contract stems from a competitive acquisition for which 16 proposals were received in response to Broad Agency Announcement HR001123S0030. DARPA, Arlington, Virginia, is the contracting activity.
